title: Ummm....
text: Ummm..... So...the quality is good and I love them...HOWEVER I ordered a 30 pack and only got 3...and sent a message but have not heard anything back. I would really like 27 more though to do what I planned on doing with them when I originally purchased but don’t want to spend more money on it. Disappointing
